subtasks: Pick up the broom, hand it over to the right hand, then use the dustpan to sweep the blocks.
Sweep the green and white blocks into the dustpan with the broom in the right hand. Keep the yellow block in the dustpan.
Pick the dropped broom up by its exposed handle with the right hand, then sweep the white block into the dustpan. Keep the green and yellow blocks in the pan.
Sweep the white and green blocks into the dustpan with the right-hand broom. Position the pan beside them and keep the yellow block inside.
Grasp the middle of the broom handle with the right hand. Sweep both adjacent blocks left into the dustpan.
Set the dustpan and broom down on the table, release both tools, and return both hands to their original resting positions.
